title: Vampire: blood rework
changes: Blood Bolt is gone. New Blood Link: bind a foe with a cord of blood and pump its life into you. Heroes who had Blood Bolt keep their points in Blood Link.
Leech now makes the foe bleed for 4s, and every hit you land on it while it bleeds gives you a Blood stack.
Boil Blood makes its victims erupt and bubble, and Exsanguinate tears streams of blood out of every foe around you.
Blood Pact now costs 2% of your life on every skill you cast.
